fix(context): keep compaction failure telemetry content-free

Replace arbitrary estimator/summarizer error text in safe telemetry with a fixed bounded description. Preserve the original returned cause and previous checkpoint. Both privacy regressions failed before the fix; 128-way failure isolation is covered.

Fresh Go 1.26.4 full planner race suite, phase 268 smoke (7 OK), scoped pinned planner lint, changed Markdown, mirror and whitespace checks pass. No new event field, API, dependency or default change. Full preflight and remaining RC gates are not claimed.
